questions.question: What did the LORD say He would do with His people when He led them into the wilderness?

answers.text: Allure them and speak to them tenderly
Leave them to wander on their own
Hand them back over to their lovers

questions.question: What did the LORD say He would remove from the lips of His people?

answers.text: The songs of their old feasts

questions.question: The LORD said He would betroth His people to Himself for only a season. True or false?
What did the LORD say He would tell the people called "Not My People"?

answers.text: You may live near My people
